g.text: Grade levels are a fixed list in the code (was the gradelevel table). Learners' parents are columns on students (was parentguardian). The section a learner is in is enrollments.section_id (was sectionassignment).

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5b6472

g.text: Not drawn, to keep the picture readable: audit_logs.user_id, and the encoded_by / reviewed_by / requested_by columns, all point to users.
